priorityList: Summon your pet (or use Grimoire of Sacrifice) before combat begins.
Use Summon Infernal on cooldown as your primary offensive burst.
Use Malevolence on cooldown, ideally synchronized with Summon Infernal or other damage buffs.
Use Soul Fire if you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards.
Cast Chaos Bolt if you have 4 or more Soul Shards, or while Malevolence or Summon Infernal is active.
Use Conflagrate if you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards and no Backdraft stacks.
Use Shadowburn if the target is below 20% health or if the Fiendish Cruelty/Conflagration of Chaos buffs are active during burst phases.
Maintain Wither on your target at all times; refresh it if it has less than 30% duration remaining.
If Internal Combustion is talented, ensure Wither is refreshed before casting Chaos Bolt.
Use Infernal Bolt whenever available if you have 3 or fewer Soul Shards.
Cast Channel Demonfire on cooldown as long as Wither is active on the target.
Cast Incinerate if the Chaotic Inferno buff is active and you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards.
Use Cataclysm on cooldown if Lake of Fire is talented.
Use Incinerate as your main filler to generate Soul Shards.
Activate offensive trinkets, potions, and racial combat abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) during your Summon Infernal window.
